{{dablink|For other uses of the word "rod," see [[Rod]].}}
The '''Nine Rods of Dominion''' were regional governors in the [[Age of Legends]]. They were previously thought by modern [[Aes Sedai]] to be a ''[[sa'angreal]]'' or a'' [[ter'angreal]]'' of some sort, and only recently was it learned that they were people.{{ref|[[Source:Blog - THIS AND THAT, 19 December 2005]]}}

==History==
[[Lews Therin Telamon]], in his position of [[First Among Servants]] in the [[Hall of Servants]], was able to summon the Rods to meet with him.{{ref/book|1|p}}
